sources.snippet: WeMM is the most recent version of the multimodal large language model introduced by WeChatCV. Capable of engaging in Chinese-English bilingual conversations alongside dynamic high-resolution images, WeMM stands as the most powerful model with 10 billion parameters in the multimodal large language model rankings.
